text: Where’s his confounded cavalry--” He stopped because of the singular stare with which his daughter was regarding him, a look that was indeed a lurid magnet for the whole group. “You old fool!” she said in a low voice without pretence of piety, “what do you suppose you are trying to prove? I tell you this man was innocent while with me. But if he wasn’t innocent, he was still with me. If he murdered a man in the garden, who was it who must have seen--who must at least have known?
